rows.title: Ryan Fazio claims Lamont ‘destroyed’ fiscal caps. But did he?
rows.standfirst: While Lamont has engaged in workarounds, he says the routine has led to savings, cut pension debt and offset federal cuts to vital services.

rows.title: Citizens’ group pledges big ideas to reform CT property tax
rows.standfirst: The Citizens’ Assembly hoping to reform Connecticut’s property tax system teased big ideas and a robust political debate.

rows.title: Scanlon: CT fiscal guardrail reform could help address special education crisis
rows.standfirst: Comptroller Sean Scanlon said Tuesday that CT can help address a special education funding crisis and still shrink its pension debt.

rows.title: GOP legislators renew call for major CT tax relief
rows.standfirst: GOP lawmakers renewed its call for major tax relief, but Democrats say Republicans would weaken efforts to shrink CT’s big pension debt.

rows.title: Report: About 570,000 CT households struggle with poverty
rows.standfirst: Household poverty shrank modestly from 2023 to 2024, based on United Way’s ALICE measure, but the organization fears poverty is now worsening.

rows.title: CT enjoys robust pension investment returns
rows.standfirst: CT’s 15.1% return ranked in the top 23% of returns achieved by major public pension funds over the past fiscal year.

rows.title: Lamont pledges to extend state employee retirement benefits
rows.standfirst: The State Employees Bargaining Agent Coalition notified rank-and-file members of the tentative understanding Thursday morning.

rows.title: Poll: Most voters favor tapping CT coffers to ease federal social service cuts
rows.standfirst: The poll found that more than half of respondents would ease CT budget caps to bolster human service programs affected by federal cuts.

rows.title: Ryan Fazio pledges unprecedented CT income tax cut
rows.standfirst: GOP gubernatorial candidate Ryan Fazio said his plan to cut income taxes would return up to $2,500 annually to middle-class families by 2031.

rows.title: Diesel fuel prices in Connecticut hit record high
rows.standfirst: The head of the Connecticut Energy Marketers Association said consumers likely will face shortages and more price increases in coming months.

rows.title: CT GOP proposes 3-month holiday on state fuel taxes
rows.standfirst: CT Republicans called for suspension of retail taxes on gasoline, diesel fuel through Dec. 31, saving motorists a collective $54M a month.
